name: query_knowledge_graph
description: Query the compiled entity relationship graph as a compact navigation index before retrieving full evidence. Use this to understand relationship bundles, multi-hop paths, the smallest set of documents to read, or a scoped map without spending tokens on raw document text.

action.description: 'context' — compact graph index for the active scope or filters; 'map' — alias for context; 'related' — neighbors of entity_name; 'path' — scoped connection path between entity_name and target_name; 'search' — scoped graph entity search by query or entity_name.

entity_name.description: Entity name to query. Required for 'related' and 'path'. Can be used as the search term for 'search'.

query.description: Optional natural-language focus or entity search text for 'context' and 'search'.

source_id.description: Optional source UUID to scope the graph. If the conversation already has a source scope, this must be inside that scope.

source_ids.description: Optional source UUIDs to scope the graph. If omitted, the active conversation source scope is used automatically.

path_prefix.description: Optional folder prefix or path segment, for example 'novel/volume-1'. Works inside a selected source or across all active sources.

relation_types.description: Optional relationship type filter, such as 'located_in' or 'causes'.

min_strength.description: Optional minimum relationship strength from 0.0 to 1.0.

limit.description: Maximum number of graph nodes to return. Default 20; capped by the tool for token efficiency.
